svg.title: Decision variables wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / SETTINGS / VARIABLES
Inputs reference variables instead of copying values.
An input that references a variable updates when the variable changes.
One save moves every reference. No copied value is left behind.
The API rejects the run. The UI shows the problem detail and
Variables have a name, a type, and a value. Types are number, percent, date, or expression.
The reference list proves a change is not copied: two inputs show 55 and one shows an expression.
Saving retirementAge as 60 updates both references in one save. The hint states how many references move.
A missing or invalid reference fails validation with a stable code and offending field; the engine never falls back
